titleEn: Jump In One at a Time!

pages.text: "Jumping here feels the coolest!" Pongi stood with both feet together at the edge of the bank. This was the place to jump into the water. Summer sunshine made the water sparkle. Behind her, her brother held his shell. "Me too!"
"My turn again!" Pongi climbed back to the same spot, still wet. Her brother waited behind. "Me too..." He hugged his shell. Pongi didn't even look back.
Pongi kept jumping first. Her brother hadn't jumped once. His mouth drooped, and he only played with his shell. The sparkling waterfront grew quiet.
Dad, in his overalls, sat beside Pongi and pointed toward the water. "What if I didn't move out of the way, Pongi?" She thought quietly. "Hmm... I'd feel sad if I couldn't jump too..."
Dad smiled. "There's only one spot, so jump in one at a time! Then big sister and little brother both get to jump." Pongi thumped her tail on the bank. "Jump in one at a time!" she repeated.

All three stood in a line at the edge. Dad called, "One, join the back of the line!" Her brother was first with his shell, and Dad was in the middle. Pongi waited at the very back, holding both paws in front of her.
Dad called, "Two, wait until the person in front jumps!" Her brother put his shell on the bank. Splash! Water sprayed up. Pongi's feet wanted to move, but she held still and waited.

At last it was Pongi's turn. Splash! She popped her head out of the water and called, "Three, move out of the spot after you jump!" Dad and her brother clapped their paws on the bank. After waiting, the jump felt even cooler!

The next day, Pongi stood at the back and called the steps first. "One, join the back of the line! Two, wait until the person in front jumps! Three, move out of the spot after you jump!" At the front, her brother gently put his shell on the bank.

Dad gave Pongi and her brother a snug hug together. "One at a time, and all three of us got into the water!" A little waiting lets both big sister and little brother jump. Pongi called, "Jump in one at a time!"
